# Curases Comprehensive Agent Integration Specification (llms-full.txt)

Curases is an agentic, zero-dependency custom cursor engine built for modern web applications.
Base URL: https://curases.com
CDN Engine: https://curases.com/engine.js
Registry API: https://curases.com/api/registry
Manifest: https://curases.com/cursors/manifest.json

---

## 1. Architectural Overview

Curases renders custom SVGs inside a high-z-index hardware-accelerated DOM container (`#custom-cursor`) positioned using CSS `transform: translate3d(tx, ty, 0)`.
- Coordinate calculations are offset by each state's defined `hotspots` vector: `(x - hotspotX * size, y - hotspotY * size)`.
- Position smoothing uses lerp (linear interpolation) on each `requestAnimationFrame`:
  `tx += (targetX - tx) * speed`
  `ty += (targetY - ty) * speed`
- Predictive edge dive tracks an EMA pointer velocity (`alpha = 0.4`) and projects it forward (`42ms` by default). Exit confidence is `clamp(v_normal / exitThreshold, 0, 1) * cos(theta)`, so parallel motion along an edge never triggers capture. A virtual dive horizon sits `edgeBuffer` px (`18px` default) inside every raw boundary. A `48px` outer prediction zone (measured from the raw edge) prepares pitch/scale, and a `32px` inner well applies an ease-out magnetic lead (`leadFactor = 1 - (1 - m)^3`, where `m` is normalized over the `14px` band between the well and the horizon) that races the rendered cursor ahead of the physical pointer. The captured scale is driven directly from the rendered distance and hits `scale = 0` exactly on the virtual horizon, roughly `18px` before the pointer touches the border. Pitch reaches `45deg`, Z-axis alignment reaches `15deg`, and corners blend independent X and Y pulls. When the active bounds fill the viewport width, left/right dives are auto-suppressed (top/bottom remain active; override with `autoSuppressFlushSides: false` or `edges`). A `120ms` hysteresis lock (released when `v_normal < -0.15 px/ms`) prevents flicker. Re-entry spawns `6px` outside at `scale = 0`, pitched `45deg` inward, stays submerged while the pointer crosses the buffer, then an underdamped spring (`stiffness = 320`, `damping = 20`) injects the entry velocity and pops the cursor back onto the pointer.
- Native OS cursor is suppressed via `* { cursor: none !important; }` unless `data-hide-native="false"`.

---

## 2. Cursor State Specifications
Each cursor preset defines SVG assets for the following semantic states:
1. `normal`: Default state when hovering general non-interactive elements.
2. `hover`: Activated over links (`<a>`), buttons (`<button>`), `[role="button"]`, and elements with `data-cursor-state="hover"`.
3. `click`: Activated while pointer is pressed down (`mousedown`).
4. `typing`: Activated when hovering or focusing input fields (`input[type="text"]`, `input[type="email"]`, `input[type="password"]`, `textarea`, `[contenteditable]`).
5. `drag`: Activated when dragging draggable elements (`[draggable="true"]` or `mousedown` on interactive sliders).
6. `resize-h`: Activated over elements with cursor resize horizontal styles.
7. `resize-v`: Activated over elements with cursor resize vertical styles.
8. `move`: Activated over draggable dialogs/headers.
9. `not-allowed`: Activated over `[disabled]` buttons or `aria-disabled="true"`.

---

## 3. Framework Integration Recipes

### Next.js 14/15 App Router (`app/layout.tsx`)
```tsx
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import Script from "next/script";
import "./globals.css";

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "My Curases App",
};

export default function RootLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <head>
        <Script
          src="https://curases.com/engine.js"
          strategy="afterInteractive"
          data-cursor="Handy"
          data-size="1.0"
          data-speed="1.0"
        />
      </head>
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

### Next.js Pages Router (`pages/_app.tsx`)
```tsx
import type { AppProps } from "next/app";
import Script from "next/script";

export default function App({ Component, pageProps }: AppProps) {
  return (
    <>
      <Script
        src="https://curases.com/engine.js"
        strategy="afterInteractive"
        data-cursor="Handy"
        data-size="1.0"
      />
      <Component {...pageProps} />
    </>
  );
}
```

### React Custom Hook (`useCurases.ts`)
```tsx
import { useEffect } from "react";

declare global {
  interface Window {
    Curases?: {
      load: (id: string) => void;
      setSize: (size: number) => void;
      setSpeed: (speed: number) => void;
      setColor: (color: string) => void;
      setRoughness: (roughness: number) => void;
      setBoil: (boil: number) => void;
      setEdgeDive: (edgeDive: boolean | { edgeBuffer?: number; outerMargin?: number; magneticRadius?: number; magneticStrength?: number; exitThreshold?: number; autoSuppressFlushSides?: boolean; edges?: { top?: boolean; bottom?: boolean; left?: boolean; right?: boolean }; wallBump?: boolean; wallBumpIntensity?: number; margin?: number; lookahead?: number; scope?: string | HTMLElement | null }) => void;
      state: (state: string) => void;
      show: () => void;
      hide: () => void;
    };
  }
}

interface CurasesOptions {
  cursor?: "Handy" | string;
  size?: number;
  speed?: number;
  color?: string;
  roughness?: number;
  boil?: number;
  edgeDive?: boolean | {
    enabled?: boolean;
    edgeBuffer?: number;
    outerMargin?: number;
    magneticRadius?: number;
    magneticStrength?: number;
    exitThreshold?: number;
    autoSuppressFlushSides?: boolean;
    edges?: {
      top?: boolean;
      bottom?: boolean;
      left?: boolean;
      right?: boolean;
    };
    wallBump?: boolean;
    wallBumpIntensity?: number;
    margin?: number;
    lookahead?: number;
    scope?: string | HTMLElement | null;
    stiffness?: number;
    damping?: number;
  };
}

export function useCurases(options: CurasesOptions = {}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === "undefined") return;

    if (!window.Curases) {
      const script = document.createElement("script");
      script.src = "https://curases.com/engine.js";
      script.setAttribute("data-cursor", options.cursor || "Handy");
      if (options.size) script.setAttribute("data-size", String(options.size));
      if (options.speed) script.setAttribute("data-speed", String(options.speed));
      if (options.color) script.setAttribute("data-color", options.color);
      if (options.roughness) script.setAttribute("data-roughness", String(options.roughness));
      if (options.boil !== undefined) script.setAttribute("data-boil", String(options.boil));
      script.defer = true;
      document.head.appendChild(script);
    } else {
      if (options.cursor) window.Curases.load(options.cursor);
      if (options.size) window.Curases.setSize(options.size);
      if (options.speed) window.Curases.setSpeed(options.speed);
      if (options.color) window.Curases.setColor(options.color);
      if (options.roughness !== undefined) window.Curases.setRoughness(options.roughness);
      if (options.boil !== undefined) window.Curases.setBoil(options.boil);
    }
  }, [options.cursor, options.size, options.speed, options.color, options.roughness, options.boil]);
}
```

### Vue 3 / Nuxt 3 Composable
```vue
<script setup>
import { onMounted } from "vue";

onMounted(() => {
  if (!document.getElementById("curases-script")) {
    const s = document.createElement("script");
    s.id = "curases-script";
    s.src = "https://curases.com/engine.js";
    s.dataset.cursor = "Handy";
    s.dataset.size = "1.0";
    s.defer = true;
    document.body.appendChild(s);
  }
});
</script>
```

### Static HTML / Webflow / Shopify
```html
<!-- Curases Custom Cursor -->
<script 
  src="https://curases.com/engine.js" 
  data-cursor="Handy" 
  data-size="1.0" 
  data-speed="1.0" 
  defer>
</script>
```

---

## 4. REST Registry Endpoints

### List all cursors:
`GET https://curases.com/api/registry`
Response:
```json
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "engineUrl": "https://curases.com/engine.js",
  "cursors": [
    {
      "id": "Handy",
      "name": "Handy Cursor",
      "description": "Expressive hand-drawn multi-state cursor with precision responsive transformations.",
      "previewUrl": "https://curases.com/api/cursors/handy.json"
    }
  ]
}
```

> **Asset delivery:** Cursor JSON is served from `https://curases.com/api/cursors/{file}` with CORS enabled for every origin, so the drop-in script works on any domain. Direct browser navigation to a cursor asset URL is rejected. Operators who need domain gating can opt in by setting `CURASES_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (comma-separated full origins); this switches the API to an origin allow-list with `Vary: Origin` and private caching.

---

## 5. Cursor JSON Schema
A Curases cursor file (e.g., `blue.json`) is formatted as:
```json
{
  "name": "blue",
  "states": {
    "normal": "<svg ...>...</svg>",
    "hover": "<svg ...>...</svg>",
    "click": "<svg ...>...</svg>",
    "typing": "<svg ...>...</svg>",
    "drag": "<svg ...>...</svg>",
    "resize-h": "<svg ...>...</svg>",
    "resize-v": "<svg ...>...</svg>",
    "move": "<svg ...>...</svg>",
    "not-allowed": "<svg ...>...</svg>"
  },
  "hotspots": {
    "default": [0, 0],
    "normal": [10, 8],
    "typing": [10, 8]
  }
}
```
Hotspot coordinates determine the exact active clicking pixel of the SVG.
